hair_features.reason: The uncovered head retains dark gray swept-back hair with lighter gray streaks, a low gathered nape silhouette and thin dark brows, with no added sideburns, moustache, beard or headgear; one restrained mouth remains below the round glasses.

entries.positive_observation: The final derivative retains the approved parent RGB art: a compact yellow mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes without white sclera, one restrained dark mouth slit, and no human skin, nose or ears. Dark gray swept-back hair with lighter gray streaks, the low gathered nape silhouette and thin dark brows remain; the chin stays bare without a moustache, beard or added sideburns. Two round dark-rimmed glasses with one dark bridge remain, with no headgear or jewelry added. The dark navy/charcoal scarf retains thick folds and large pale blue-gray leaf/oval motifs over a plain dark brown coat. The image-right three-quarter pose and gaze, sober expression, upper-chest crop, directional face/scarf light and dark charcoal/brown-gray vignetted backing remain recognizable. The rounded chin meets a short broad scarf/collar transition without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. No frame, note, matte or replacement scene was invented. Full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows complete opaque backing and clothing without holes, smoke or a working-matte halo.
